title: rewrite a merged change as a subject line
provenance: The squash-commit description of a real merged change, omnibase_spi 30256be13c8f53e0d3e4f751b444a54162e38c2d.
prompt:
Rewrite this merged change's description as a commit-message subject line: imperative mood, no trailing period. Keep the ticket identifier OMN-2235 and the name `reporting_source` exactly as written. Add nothing the description does not state. At most 16 words.

CHANGE (omnibase_spi#81):
feat(spi): add LLM cost tracking contracts [OMN-2235]

* feat(spi): add LLM cost tracking contracts [OMN-2235]

Add per-call LLM metrics and usage normalization contracts:

- ContractLlmCallMetrics: model_id, prompt/completion/total tokens,
  estimated_cost_usd, latency_ms, plus global invariant fields
  (input_hash, code_version, contract_version, timestamp, source)
- ContractLlmUsageRaw: verbatim provider response stored as dict
- ContractLlmUsageNormalized: canonical form with source/estimated flag
  and model validator enforcing source-flag consistency
- ContractEnumUsageSource: API | ESTIMATED | MISSING provenance enum

All contracts follow measurement conventions: frozen=True,
extra="forbid", explicit extensions dict, schema_version field.

* fix(review): address CodeRabbit feedback on LLM cost tracking contracts [OMN-2235]

- Add docstrings to all test methods to satisfy docstring coverage check
- Add test_dict_round_trip for ContractLlmUsageNormalized for symmetry
- Document intentional independence of top-level usage_is_estimated
  from nested usage_normalized.usage_is_estimated

* fix(review): enforce total_tokens == prompt + completion per CodeRabbit [OMN-2235]

Add model validators to ContractLlmUsageNormalized and
ContractLlmCallMetrics ensuring total_tokens equals
prompt_tokens + completion_tokens.  Prevents silent
inconsistency in canonical metric data.

* fix(review): add cross-validation and improve field docs for LLM cost contracts [OMN-2235]

* fix(review): disambiguate source fields, add model_id and estimation flag validation [OMN-2235]

- Rename top-level `source` to `reporting_source` to avoid confusion with
  `usage_normalized.source` (ContractEnumUsageSource enum)
- Add min_length=1 to model_id to reject empty strings
- Add cross-validation: usage_is_estimated must agree with
  usage_normalized.usage_is_estimated when both present
- Add tests for empty model_id, estimation flag disagreement, zero cost
- Update input_hash fixture to use algorithm-prefixed format

* fix(review): correct docstring, add timestamp validation and edge case tests [OMN-2235]

---------
